capita-mercury-2024: Stable and capable at speed and in everyday riding; a couple noticed a catchy slow-speed twitch.
capita-mercury-2025: A great all-rounder with edge hold and stability at speed, but several found it sluggish in the park.
capita-the-black-snowboard-of-death-2025: Fast and fun, carving well for freeriding; reviews differ on the flex, some calling it stiff.
